$description: Sticker settings (guidelines/print/stickers.md, visual designer, 2026-11-27). Sizes in mm. The vendor's spec always wins for bleed, safe area, cut line name and profile.

bleed.$description: mm of paper white past a contour cut; 2 mm of image past a shape's cut. The vendor's value wins

safe.$description: mm inside the cut, the vendor's cutting tolerance

border.$description: White border and the logo's backing, the same width (to confirm: the hand-made reference is closer to 3 mm)

closeMm.$description: Smooths notches where the logo tab meets the border

minDetailMm.$description: No inside corners or necks tighter than this

logo.$description: Light logo on its white backing; its bottom edge sits 0.3 x its height over the artwork

margin.$value: 8% of the short side, at least 1.5 x safe

minHeightMm.$description: Sticker exception to the 0.84 cm print minimum

reachMax.$description: The fade runs up to 70% of the sticker from the edge nearest the logo

steps.$description: Image left at the edge: 1.0 = no mask; 0.2 = 80%, the strongest

max.$description: Above 80% at the edge, generate the image again instead

subjectFocal.$description: The upper 60% of the subject (head, torso, hands) is never darkened (1% at most)

mask.toward: rich black C40 M0 Y0 K100 in print, neutral 950 on screen

spotName.$description: Some vendors use Thru-cut, KissCut or Die: the vendor's name wins
